en: Black‑and‑white image of a street with traditional half‑timbered houses and ornate wooden balconies. Several people stand on the sidewalk in early‑20th‑century clothing, and a small steam locomotive with carriages passes on tracks at the right edge. Mature trees line the street; one large tree dominates the right foreground. The architecture mixes plastered walls with visible timber framing typical of Central European towns.
